ud4.9:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati, veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
ud4.9:1.3: atha kho āyasmato upasenassa vaṅgantaputtassa rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
ud4.9:1.5: satthā ca me bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho.
ud4.9:1.6: svākkhāte camhi dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
